releaseNotesMarkdown:
### hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes (kubernetes)

### [`v3.5.0`](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#350-Nov-5-2026)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/compare/v3.4.0...v3.5.0)

NOTES:

- `resource/kubernetes_cluster_role_binding_v1`: Migrated from SDKv2 to the Plugin Framework, keeping the existing configuration syntax and supporting existing state without re-import. `moved` blocks from the deprecated `kubernetes_cluster_role_binding` resource are supported with Terraform 1.8 or later. Some bindings show a one-time in-place update after upgrading, never a replacement: explicitly empty `labels` or `annotations`, a `User` or `Group` subject with `api_group = ""` (shown as `- api_group = "rbac.authorization.k8s.io" -> null`; only Terraform state changes, not the binding), and a binding named with `name` when planned with `-refresh=false`. \[[GH-2976](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2976)]
- `resource/kubernetes_role_binding_v1`: Migrated from SDKv2 to the Plugin Framework, preserving configuration syntax and supporting existing state without re-import. Some bindings show a one-time in-place update after upgrading, never a replacement: explicitly empty `labels` or `annotations`, a `User` or `Group` subject with `api_group = ""` (shown as `- api_group = "rbac.authorization.k8s.io" -> null`; only Terraform state changes, not the binding), and a binding named with `name` when planned with `-refresh=false`. Moving from the deprecated `kubernetes_role_binding` type is supported with Terraform 1.8 or later. See the Plugin Framework upgrade guide for details. \[[GH-2978](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2978)]

BREAKING CHANGES:

- `resource/kubernetes_cluster_role_binding_v1`: `null` is no longer accepted as a value in `metadata.labels` or `metadata.annotations`. Earlier versions accepted it and silently dropped the entry. \[[GH-2976](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2976)]
- `resource/kubernetes_role_binding_v1`: `null` is no longer accepted as a value in `metadata.labels` or `metadata.annotations`. Earlier versions accepted it and silently dropped the entry. \[[GH-2978](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2978)]
- `resource/kubernetes_role_binding_v1`: Setting both `metadata.name` and `metadata.generate_name` is now rejected at plan time, including `generate_name = ""`. Previously the Kubernetes API silently ignored `generate_name` when `name` was set. To keep the existing RoleBinding, remove `generate_name` if it is empty; otherwise remove `name` and retain the original `generate_name`. Removing or changing a stored non-empty prefix replaces the RoleBinding. \[[GH-2978](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2978)]

DEPRECATIONS:

- `resource/kubernetes_horizontal_pod_autoscaler_v2beta2`: Deprecated and will be removed in version 4.0 of the provider. Use `kubernetes_horizontal_pod_autoscaler_v2` instead. \[[GH-3031](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/3031)]

### [`v3.4.0`](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#340-Oct-16-2026)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/compare/v3.3.0...v3.4.0)

BREAKING CHANGES:

- `resource/kubernetes_role_v1`: Setting both `metadata.name` and `metadata.generate_name` is now rejected during plan, including `generate_name = ""`. Earlier versions allowed it, but the Kubernetes API ignores `generate_name` whenever `name` is set. To keep the existing Role, remove `generate_name` if it is empty (`""`); otherwise remove `name` and keep `generate_name`. Making the other change replaces the Role. \[[GH-2964](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2964)]
- `resource/kubernetes_role_v1`: `null` is no longer accepted as a value in `metadata.labels` or `metadata.annotations`. Earlier versions accepted it and silently dropped the entry. \[[GH-2964](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2964)]

BUG FIXES:

- provider: Bump `google.golang.org/grpc` to v1.83.2 and `github.com/moby/spdystream` to v0.5.1 to resolve GO-2026-6348, GO-2026-6443, and CVE-2026-35469. \[[GH-2986](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2986)]

NOTES:

- `resource/kubernetes_role_v1`: Import IDs require a non-empty namespace and name. \[[GH-2964](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2964)]
- `resource/kubernetes_role_v1`: Migrated from SDKv2 to the Plugin Framework, preserving configuration syntax and resource identity, including upgrades from versions before identity support. `moved` blocks from the deprecated `kubernetes_role` resource are supported with Terraform 1.8 or later. Explicit empty metadata maps may require a one-time in-place update. Roles imported with an earlier provider version may show a one-time in-place update setting empty `labels` and `annotations` to null, and a `terraform plan -refresh=false` immediately after upgrading may show a one-time in-place update adding `resource_names = []`; neither replaces the Role. Identity imports default an omitted namespace to `default`. See the Plugin Framework upgrade guide for details. \[[GH-2964](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2964)]

### [`v3.3.0`](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#330-Oct-12026)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/compare/v3.2.1...v3.3.0)

BREAKING CHANGES:

- `resource/kubernetes_namespace_v1`: Validate that `metadata.labels` and `metadata.annotations` entries contain non-null strings. Previously accepted null entries are now rejected during planning; omit those entries or provide string values. Entire maps may still be omitted or set to `null`. \[[GH-2979](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2979)]

BUG FIXES:

- `data-source/kubernetes_namespace_v1`: Report a missing `metadata.name` during validation instead of failing during the namespace lookup. \[[GH-2960](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2960)]
- `resource/kubernetes_stateful_set_v1`: Fix `Missing Resource Identity After Update` error when `wait_for_rollout` is `true` and the StatefulSet is updated in place \[[GH-2967](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2967)]
- provider: Bump `google.golang.org/grpc` to v1.82.1 and `golang.org/x/crypto` to v0.52.0 to resolve upstream security advisories. \[[GH-2959](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2959)]

NOTES:

- `data-source/kubernetes_all_namespaces`: Migrated from SDKv2 to the Plugin Framework. \[[GH-2962](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2962)]
- `data-source/kubernetes_namespace_v1`: Migrated from SDKv2 to the Plugin Framework. \[[GH-2960](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2960)]
- `resource/kubernetes_namespace_v1`: Migrated from terraform-plugin-sdk/v2 to terraform-plugin-framework, retaining the existing resource name and configuration block syntax. `moved` blocks from the deprecated `kubernetes_namespace` resource are supported. Explicitly empty metadata maps may produce a one-time in-place update after upgrading. \[[GH-2979](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2979)]

### [`v3.2.1`](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#321-Jun-30-2026)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/compare/v3.2.0...v3.2.1)

BUG FIXES:

- `resource/*`: Fix `Unexpected Identity Change` error after apply when a resource takes a long time to become ready; bump `terraform-plugin-sdk` to v2.38.2 \[[GH-2859](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2859)]
- `resource/kubernetes_secret_v1`: Fix `Missing Resource Identity After Create` error when using `data_wo` or `binary_data_wo` write-only attributes \[[GH-2859](https://redirect.github.com/hashicorp/terraform-provider-kubernetes/issues/2859)]
